name: 桌面文件读写
description: 让远端工作区的会话直接读写删桌面机上的文件；push/pull 直传让大文件字节不经 LLM 上下文。0.5.0 起默认走 SSH（sftp，零用户操作，复用桌面既有 ssh 配置），HTTP 通道保留为 mode:'http'。
author: duya07

agentTools.name: read_desktop_file
agentTools.description: Read a file from the local (desktop) filesystem and return its bytes as base64. Use this when a session running against a remote host needs a file that only exists on the desktop machine. Supports offset/length for chunked reads of large files.

path.description: Absolute path on the desktop, e.g. C:/Users/me/notes.txt

agentTools.name: list_desktop_dir
agentTools.description: List one directory's entries on the local (desktop) filesystem.

path.description: Absolute directory path on the desktop

agentTools.name: write_desktop_file
agentTools.description: Write bytes (base64) to a file on the local (desktop) filesystem. Overwriting an existing file REQUIRES expectedSha256 taken from read_desktop_file; creating a new file REQUIRES allowCreate:true. Returns before/after size and sha256 so the caller can audit the change. Only use with explicit user authorization for the specific path.

expectedSha256.description: Required when overwriting: sha256 of the current file content (from read_desktop_file)

allowCreate.description: Required when the file does not exist yet

agentTools.name: delete_desktop_file
agentTools.description: Delete ONE regular file on the local (desktop) filesystem. Refuses directories (no recursion), symbolic links, filesystem roots, Windows/Program Files/ProgramData, .ssh/.gnupg/.aws/.pi-desktop and NTFS system files. Requires confirm:true plus expectedSha256 (preferred) or expectedSize taken from read_desktop_file/list_desktop_dir; the delete is refused if the file changed since. Use dryRun:true first to preview. Only use with explicit user authorization for the specific path.

path.description: Absolute path of the single file to delete

confirm.description: Must be true: explicit confirmation that the impact was reviewed

expectedSha256.description: Preferred guard: sha256 of the current content (from read_desktop_file). Refused if it changed.

expectedSize.description: Alternative guard for large files you did not read in full: current byte size (from list_desktop_dir)

dryRun.description: If true, only report what would be deleted; nothing is removed

agentTools.name: push_desktop_file_to_remote
agentTools.description: Push a desktop file to the remote host, bytes never pass through LLM context. Default channel is SSH over the desktop's existing ssh config (zero user setup): call list_ssh_hosts first to see which aliases exist and let the user pick one, then pass host (ssh-config alias or user@host) + remotePath and the file is uploaded with sftp (BatchMode, no interaction; put overwrites an existing remote file). The local source path must not contain the glob metacharacters * ? [ (rejected conservatively: modern OpenSSH escapes them inside quoted args, older or non-OpenSSH clients glob-expand them and could silently transfer a different file). Backslashes are fine — Windows paths like C:\Users\me\f.txt work. The remote destination is not glob-expanded. expectedRemoteSha256 is rejected on the ssh channel (the remote file is never read back). The 0.4.0 HTTP channel is kept: pass mode:'http' with remoteUrl (unrestricted — only call with a user-authorized destination; auth via Authorization: Bearer <token> header). Requires explicit user authorization for the specific path and destination. Returns sha256/size for verification.

path.description: Absolute path on the desktop to push

mode.description: Transport: 'ssh' (sftp, default when host is given) or 'http' (0.4.0 channel, needs remoteUrl). Omit to infer from which fields are present; passing both host and remoteUrl without mode is an error.

host.description: SSH: ssh-config alias on the desktop (recommended — reuses its existing ssh config and key, nothing to set up) or user@host. Call list_ssh_hosts first and let the user pick when it is not obvious. No spaces; must not start with '-'.

port.description: SSH: TCP port (1-65535) if not already set in the ssh config entry

remotePath.description: SSH: absolute remote destination path, e.g. /srv/transfer/file.bin. No control characters. put overwrites if the file exists (scp-like semantics). Unlike the source path, the destination is NOT glob-expanded, so [ * ? are allowed here.

remoteUrl.description: HTTP: destination http(s) URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9876/push/file.bin or https://example.com/dfr/push/file.bin (auth via Authorization: Bearer <token> header; putting token in URL is supported for compatibility but will appear in access logs — not recommended)

token.description: HTTP only: Bearer token; sent as Authorization: Bearer <token> header if >=16 chars. Do not put token in the URL — it will appear in access logs. Path token /push/<token>/ is only for compatibility.

expectedSha256.description: Optional guard: sha256 of the current file; refused if it changed

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in ms. HTTP: 5000-120000, default 60000. SSH: 5000-1800000, default 300000. On SSH timeout the sftp process is killed.

method.description: HTTP only: PUT or POST (default PUT)

agentTools.name: pull_remote_file_to_desktop
agentTools.description: Pull a remote file and save it to a desktop path, bytes never pass through LLM context. Default channel is SSH over the desktop's existing ssh config (zero user setup): call list_ssh_hosts first to see which aliases exist and let the user pick one, then pass host (ssh-config alias or user@host) + remotePath and the file is downloaded with sftp (BatchMode, no interaction) to a temp file, sha256-verified, then atomically renamed. The remote source path must not contain the glob metacharacters * ? [ (rejected conservatively: modern OpenSSH escapes them inside quoted args, older or non-OpenSSH clients glob-expand them and could silently fetch a different file). The local destination is not glob-expanded. The 0.4.0 HTTP channel is kept: pass mode:'http' with remoteUrl (unrestricted — only call with a user-authorized source; auth via Authorization header). Overwrite requires expectedSha256 of the current target; create requires allowCreate:true. expectedRemoteSha256 is honoured on the ssh channel (compared with the sha of the received file). Requires explicit user authorization for the specific path and source.

mode.description: Transport: 'ssh' (sftp, default when host is given) or 'http' (0.4.0 channel, needs remoteUrl). Omit to infer from which fields are present; passing both host and remoteUrl without mode is an error.

host.description: SSH: ssh-config alias on the desktop (recommended — reuses its existing ssh config and key, nothing to set up) or user@host. Call list_ssh_hosts first and let the user pick when it is not obvious. No spaces; must not start with '-'.

port.description: SSH: TCP port (1-65535) if not already set in the ssh config entry

remotePath.description: SSH: absolute remote source path, e.g. /srv/transfer/file.bin. No control characters. MUST NOT contain the glob metacharacters * ? [ (rejected conservatively: modern OpenSSH escapes them inside quoted args, older or non-OpenSSH clients glob-expand the get source).

remoteUrl.description: HTTP: source http(s) URL to GET, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9876/pull/file.bin or https://example.com/dfr/pull/file.bin (auth via Authorization header; token in URL is compatibility-only and will appear in logs)

token.description: HTTP only: Bearer token; sent as Authorization: Bearer <token> header if >=16 chars. Do not put token in the URL.

expectedRemoteSha256.description: HTTP only: optional guard, expected sha256 of the remote content (compared against the X-File-SHA256 header or the received bytes). On the SSH channel this is honoured for pull (compared with the sha of the received file) and REJECTED for push (the remote file is never read back, so it cannot be verified).

expectedSha256.description: Required when overwriting: sha256 of the current target file

allowCreate.description: Required when the file does not exist yet

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in ms. HTTP: 5000-120000, default 60000. SSH: 5000-1800000, default 300000. On SSH timeout the sftp process is killed.

agentTools.name: list_ssh_hosts
agentTools.description: List the concrete Host aliases defined in the DESKTOP machine's ~/.ssh/config, with the hostname / port / user each alias resolves to (never key paths). Read-only, no network. Call this FIRST when you need to move a file to or from a remote host: show the candidates to the user, let them choose, then pass the chosen alias as the host argument of push_desktop_file_to_remote / pull_remote_file_to_desktop. The plugin never picks a host by itself.
